weaverbird-cli.notes:
WeaverBird CLI v0.2.3

- **Daemon mode**: Added `weaverbird daemon start/stop/status` commands
- **Systemd integration**: Automatic service installation and management
- **Background agent**: Run WeaverBird as a system service with root privileges

- Downloads site now prioritizes DEB packages over tarballs
- Added copy button feedback (shows "✓ Copied!" for 2 seconds)
- Added navigation back to home page from downloads site
- Removed snap installation method (requires classic confinement)
- Install script no longer prints temp directory paths

WeaverBird can now run as a privileged system service to manage infrastructure:
- Install system software (Docker, etc.)
- Manage services and configurations
- Connect to WeaverBird platform as a persistent agent

```bash
sudo dpkg -i weaverbird_0.2.3_amd64.deb

sudo weaverbird generate-pair

sudo systemctl enable --now weaverbird-agent
```
